subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept replacing fs.glob-based extra-bootstrap resolution with this yielding walker for all configured glob patterns before merge?
rationale: The patch appears correct and well-tested, but this is a compatibility-sensitive runtime behavior change for existing bootstrap-extra-files configs, and automation cannot decide the permanent traversal/ordering contract for maintainers.

options.title: Accept Walker With Exact-Head Gates
options.body: Merge after rebase/exact-head CI if maintainers accept the tested fs.glob-parity contract and the remaining traversal-order compatibility risk.

options.title: Narrow The Resolver Change
options.body: Ask the author to keep fs.glob for low-risk patterns or otherwise reduce the behavior delta while still fixing broad-glob event-loop stalls.

options.title: Pause For Live Channel Proof
options.body: Hold the PR until a real embedded_run/channel scenario demonstrates that channel I/O remains live during bootstrap-context on a representative workspace.

recommendation.title: Accept Walker With Exact-Head Gates
recommendation.body: Merge after rebase/exact-head CI if maintainers accept the tested fs.glob-parity contract and the remaining traversal-order compatibility risk.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across bootstrap file loading, hook contracts, and embedded-agent runtime ownership for this compatibility decision.
